facts.business: Howard Hotels Limited is engaged in the business of hospitality and hotel operations, deriving revenue primarily from room revenue, food & beverage services, banquet and event services, and other hospitality services.
key_risks: fluctuations in tourist arrivals and travel patterns
intense competition from existing and new hospitality players
rising costs of manpower, utilities and maintenance
changes in regulatory and statutory requirements
unforeseen events such as geopolitical developments, public health concerns, and natural calamities
